request.description:
Equipment records cannot be created through this endpoint. A create request returns `Process Equipment can only be created by Library Services or internal system operations.` — an Equipment record comes into being by adding a library equipment unit to a process in the application, so only Edit and the Propose requests below apply here.

An edit must resend `EquipmentFlows` along with the matching `UnitOperations` (and `Steps`) entries. Omitting them detaches the record from its unit operation and the request is rejected to avoid corrupting dependent records.
